issue.title: AttributeError: Unable to lookup 'transit_processor' on TransitAgency or TransitAgencyAdmin or TransitAgencyForm

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the admin 'transit_processor' lookup error and found the fix guards against it, but it also found a regression: TestTransitAgencyAdmin.test_get_readonly_fields[staff-expected0] passed before the fix and fails after it. Look next at how the fix changed the staff user's readonly fields on TransitAgencyAdmin, and whether that test's expected list or the fix needs to change.
